notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001713445-26-000022, filed February 6, 2026), reported in thousands; the stock-comp value matches SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 23, 2026, accession 0001713445-26-000060), based on 141,867,916 Class A and 50,543,398 Class B shares outstanding at March 31, 2026. LEADER: Alexis Ohanian, co-founder, is not a director, nominee, named executive officer or 5% holder in the 2026 proxy, so no holding is reported. HOLDERS: the proxy gives 5% holders only as percentages of each class and of voting power, not of all shares, so only Advance is recorded, from the 10-K's stated all-class figure (approximately 22% at December 31, 2025). For reference, the proxy's class figures at March 31, 2026 are: Advance Magazine Publishers 16,182 Class A and 42,191,092 Class B (83.5% of Class B, 65.2% of votes); entities affiliated with Tencent 2,150,425 Class A (1.5%) and 3,755,172 Class B (7.4%), 6.1% of votes. FMR, Vanguard and Coatue no longer appear among the 5% holders. These are not converted to all-share percentages here. Steven Huffman's own holding is 1,868,737 Class A (1.3%) and 3,786,584 Class B (7.4%), 6.1% of votes; his 76.1% voting total adds the Advance and Tencent shares he votes by proxy. BUYBACKS: no share repurchases in 2025 (the 10-K says none were made in the fourth quarter and the cash-flow statement has no repurchase line); the $104.0 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of RSUs is not a buyback. The board authorized a $1 billion Class A repurchase program on February 4, 2026, after the fiscal year. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow figure of $343.2 million (2024: $801.6 million, inflated by IPO-related RSU vesting). PLAN: the 10-K lists an Employee Stock Purchase Plan only as an exhibit and does not describe it, so plan is null.
